items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] So now, when you were back in Europe -- that's where we started, with you going back to Europe. Then we started talking about Jean Bigard.

ctx.x: You see, anytime something -- things like doing two minute things to something white in America, they're going to stop that. They going to let him alone, see. They're going to let him alone. They love to see other people's blood be flowing, but when this other man says, well, I want his mother to do a bit of crying too (audible). That's what happened.
So now, when you were back in Europe -- that's where we started, with you going back to Europe. Then we started talking about Jean Bigard. Okay, now, what happened to you during this second trip?
Well, first, when I went back, Europe had been changed.
